```yaml
name: Test flake

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - flake.nix
      - flake.lock
      - .github/workflows/test-flake.yml
      - rust-toolchain.toml
      - '**/Cargo.toml'
      - '**/Cargo.lock'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - flake.nix
      - flake.lock
      - .github/workflows/test-flake.yml
      - rust-toolchain.toml
      - '**/Cargo.toml'
      - '**/Cargo.lock'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  flake-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v18
        with:
          installInputs: nix flake

      - name: Run nix flake check
        run: nix flake check

      - name: Test dev shell initialization
        run: nix develop -c echo "dev shell initialized"
```
